findings.text: the reviewed manifest carries the two gate logs under test_logs and a prose tests line, but not the dispatch contract's baseline_suite/after_suite JSON objects, so the review store's own read path (reckon/crew/review.py annotate_review_of_run) finds no base or head log and will report this run's added-failure count as unmeasured when the record is read back, even though both logs show zero failures and this record records 0. _ticker_layout_signature keys on an unordered-at-the-render-level list of fixed-grid constants plus MIN_WIDTH; a move that reorders the fixed cells while preserving the multiset of widths and the composed MIN_WIDTH would leave the signature unchanged and print no marker, so a genuine layout move could pass unmarked. No such reorder exists in the tree today and the plan's stated cases do not cover it; recorded so the next reader knows the signature's boundary rather than assuming it sees every layout change.
